description:
Episode 1 & 4: Shigure Chapter
One day, Kita Komatsu stayed back late to clean the classroom. While he was under the teacher's table, a female student enters the classroom and proceeds to masturbate. While that fact is shocking in itself, Kita Komatsu is even more shocked when he realizes that the female student is student council president Takashima Shigure. She is attractive, excels at both academics and sports, and is looked up upon by both the boys and girls of the school. Kita Komatsu attempts to escape, but he trips and is discovered by Shigure.

Episode 2: Konomi Chapter
Konomi and her brother are not blood related, but they are as close as any siblings. One night, while having dinner together, Onii-chan's gaze is irresistibly drawn to the two large prominent mounds covered by her sweater.

Episode 3: Miyuki Chapter
Miyuki has an unspeakable secret: Even at this age, she goes into the bath together with her father. Today, once again, while her mother is out of the house, Miyuki and her father are together. After washing her body, she climbs into the bathtub where her father awaits. As she leans back against his chest, his arms unhesitatingly snakes around to fondle her breast...
